records.name: Pectoralis major
records.actions: Shoulder horizontal adduction; assists shoulder flexion depending on region and position

records.name: Latissimus dorsi
records.actions: Shoulder extension, adduction and internal rotation

records.name: Deltoids
records.actions: Anterior: shoulder flexion; middle: abduction; posterior: horizontal abduction/extension

records.name: Triceps brachii
records.actions: Elbow extension; long head also crosses shoulder

records.name: Biceps / brachialis
records.actions: Elbow flexion; biceps also supination and shoulder contribution

records.name: Quadriceps
records.actions: Knee extension; rectus femoris also hip flexion

records.name: Hamstrings
records.actions: Hip extension and knee flexion (biarticular roles vary)

records.name: Gluteus maximus
records.actions: Hip extension and external rotation; contributes to hip control

records.name: Calf complex
records.actions: Plantarflexion; soleus and gastrocnemius differ by knee position

records.name: Trunk musculature
records.actions: Resists or produces flexion, extension, rotation and lateral flexion; stabilises trunk
